program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (norm cells) (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<?))
    (define (reflect-v cells)
      (let* ((s (norm cells))
             (w (+ 1 (apply max (map second s)))))
        (norm (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (- w 1 (second p)))) s))))
    (define comps (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0)))
    (define flags (map (lambda (obj) (equal? (norm (obj-cells obj)) (reflect-v (obj-cells obj)))) comps))
    (define true-count (count-where (lambda (v) v) flags))
    (define false-count (- (length flags) true-count))
    (if (and (> true-count 0) (> false-count 0) (or (= true-count 1) (= false-count 1)))
        (let* ((target-flag (= true-count 1))
               (pairs (map list comps flags))
               (target (first (first (filter (lambda (p) (equal? (second p) target-flag)) pairs)))))
          (paint-cells g (obj-cells target) 2))
        g)))
